associations.rationale: The formal type proves general connectivity of the McKay graph, but it does not state the two-vertex double-edge affine A1 case.
The formal type gives a Cartan null-vector equation for representation dimensions, which may support the case analysis but does not handle the two-vertex double edge itself.
The formal type concludes that a McKay adjacency is an affine Dynkin diagram only under 3 <= m, so it does not state the source's two-vertex case.
The formal type proves symmetry of McKay multiplicities, a useful graph property, but does not state the two-vertex double-edge conclusion.
